tools.name: scan_spill_container_label_sds
tools.description: Optical spill, container & label scanner that identifies both the exact commercial manufacturer and the manufacturer-specific 16-section OSHA SDS (SKU/Part#, CHEMTREC contract hotline, exact % wt CAS formulation, and spill neutralization protocol).

parameters.ocr_text: Visible label text, manufacturer name, brand, SKU/Part#, UN/DOT placard, or barcode
parameters.spill_appearance: Visual appearance of the spill pool, vapor cloud, color, or reaction on concrete
parameters.container_hint: Container shape, material, or color profile
parameters.dominant_colors: Dominant RGB/HSV chromatic tags extracted from the camera frame

tools.name: search_hazmat_chemicals
tools.description: Search 62+ hazardous chemicals by Name, UN/NA 4-digit placard number, CAS number, synonym, or category (Automotive, Retail/Consumer, Industrial, Warehouse, CBRN/Warfare).

parameters.category: ALL | Automotive | Retail/Consumer | Industrial | Warehouse | CBRN/Warfare

tools.name: get_full_16_section_osha_sds
tools.description: Retrieve complete OSHA HazCom 2012 16-section Safety Data Sheet (SDS), NFPA 704 ratings, NIOSH/OSHA/IDLH limits, and clinical antidote for a chemical ID.

tools.name: calculate_erg_wind_plume
tools.description: Calculate ERG 2024 Initial Isolation Zone (Hot Zone), Downwind Protective Action Distance (PAD) cone, and Upwind Apparatus Staging compass vector using live Open-Meteo wind or manual wind inputs.

tools.name: evaluate_cameo_reactivity
tools.description: Evaluate NOAA CAMEO binary chemical reactivity, toxic gas generation (HCN, Cl2, NH2Cl, H2S, HF, Phosgene), and explosion hazards when two chemicals mix.

tools.name: check_warehouse_storage_segregation
tools.description: Check OSHA/GHS warehouse & shop cabinet storage compatibility between two chemicals across 25 segregation rules.

tools.name: generate_fema_ics208_safety_plan
tools.description: Generate a print-ready FEMA ICS-208 HazMat Site Safety and Control Plan with Hot/Warm/Cold zones, PPE, decon, and medical countermeasures.

tools.name: identify_unknown_spill_by_symptoms
tools.description: Reverse-identify an unknown chemical release from observed odor, vapor/liquid color, physical state, and patient toxidrome symptoms.
